_comment: One entry per bank or card CSV export, read with `finance txn import --csv <file> --format <name>`. A new bank is a config entry, not code: the money bot adds one the first time you send that bank's CSV (PDFs and screenshots need no entry; the bot reads them itself). Column names must match the export's header row exactly. Use amount_column for one signed column, or debit_column and credit_column (debit_is_positive: true when debits are written unsigned). Set skip_rows where the bank writes lines (often the account number) above the header: they are skipped and never stored. account_id is your alias for the account (spend_accounts.csv), never its number. currency defaults to your home currency. Check the first import against the file before trusting the numbers.
